URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Graph.]
Cutting and downward pressure in both kidneys before urinating.
Anxious pressure in bladder, with sudden desire to urinate, but scanty emission.
Frequent urination, particularly at night.
Urging to urinate, with scanty discharge.
Urging to urinate, with dribbling after the usual discharge.
Urine clear, but after four or five hours, covered with an iridescent film.
Urine becomes turbid and deposits a white sediment.
Urine becomes very turbid after two hours, with reddish sediment ; biting in urethra while passing it.
Urine : dark brown ; fetid ; sour.
Stitches or smarting in urethra when urinating.
Urinary troubles, with burning in urethra between acts of micturition.
Very thin stream of urine, as if urethra were contracted.
Pain in sacrum or coccygis when urinating.
Nocturnal enuresis.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Graph.]
Uncontrollable sexual excitement ; violent erections.
Voluptuous irritability of genitals.
Tension and lascivious feeling in genitals.
Revival of sexual desire and fantasies.
Pollutions with weakness and pain in sacrum ; neuralgic pains in back of neck.
Seminal emissions at night, with flaccid penis ; they wake him, but no voluptuous feelings ; sensation of great weakness in genitals ; costiveness ; from previous sexual abuse.
Emissions with amorous dreams.
Sexual weakness, consisting of lively desire with incomplete erection and too rapid or too early discharge of semen, such as sometimes follows the habit of masturbation, acquired in boyhood and abandoned early.
Almost involuntary emission, without much erection, during an embrace.
Sexual debility from sexual abuse.
Decided aversion to coition.
Impotence, with dislike to coition.
Want of proper sensation during coition.
Painful cramps in calves during an embrace.
No ejaculation follows coition in spite of every exertion.
After an embrace coldness of legs, exhaustion, heat of body and perspiration.
Dropsical swelling of prepuce and scrotum.
Herpetic eruptions on penis.
Prepuce swells to a large water blister without pain.
Vesicular eruption on prepuce.
Testes swollen.
Hydrocele (l. side), herpetic eruption on scrotum, in groins, or on lower extremities either preceding or accompanying the disease, or when arising from suppression of cutaneous disease.
Itching and moist eruption on scrotum.
Itching on scrotum.
Gonorrhœa.
Stricture of urethra with sudden arrest of flow, then oozing of snuff-colored slime in a long thread, or, instead, a few drops of bloody water ; after micturition sudden peremptory urging near glans, or seems to run back when costive.
Gluey, sticky discharge at meatus urinarius, blocking up urethra. θ Gleet.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Graph.]
Great aversion to coitus.
Enlarged ovaries, which become more tender and more enlarged every time she takes cold or gets her feet damp.
Swelling and hardness of ovaries after menses.
Tearing, grinding, twisting pains in right ovary, as if it would burst, before or during menses.
The indurated left ovary swells and becomes very hard ; violent pains on touch, respiration or hawking, when violent stitches shoot into it ; profuse general sweat ; continual loss of sleep.
Tumors, size of an orange, in right iliac fossa, also similar one in left ; both hard, round, slightly movable ; not painful to pressure, nor producing inconvenience from weight.
Bearing down pain in uterus to back, with weakness and sickness. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Pain in uterus when reaching high with arms.
Os uteri standing backwards, can only be reached with difficulty.
Cauliflower excrescences ; cancer uteri ; severe lancinating, stitching pains through uterus down to lower extremities ; heaviness of abdomen with increased pain when standing.
Hot and painful vagina ; swelling of lymphatic vessels and mucous follicles ; neck of uterus hard and swollen, with tuberculous nodes and cauliflower excrescences ; great weight in abdomen on rising, with fainting sort of weakness and < of pains ; delaying menses, with < of pains shortly before and at appearance of menses ; discharge of black, lumpy, fetid blood ; stitches shooting through abdomen as far as thighs ; burning and stitching pains ; constipation ; livid complexion ; sad and anxious mood. θ Cancer uteri.
Bearing down pain in womb, with weakness and sinking ; pain over eyes ; pain in middle of breast, with cough, scraping, rawness and soreness. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Retarded, deficient menstruation ; discharge watery, thin, and in small quantities ; pulse thin ; constitution feeble ; sick headache, with pain over eyes and numb pain from sacrum down legs ; cold hands and feet ; acne solare in face. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
After mental trouble during menstruation suffered for five years from dysmenorrhœa.
Great emaciation with paleness of face ; terrible pain in small of back and abdomen, which compel her to stay in bed ; for next five days constant discharge of coagula with continuous cramps, so severe that she cries out aloud with pain ; want of appetite ; stools scanty and painful ; spasmodic urination.
Dysmenorrhœa with severe and obstinate megrim.
Menses delayed, scanty, thick and dark, or else serous pale blood, with griping and abdominal spasms, headache, nausea and pain in chest.
Occasional show of menses which are very pale and very scanty, with abdominal pains and pains in limbs ; swelling of hands and feet.
Menses : too scanty and too pale ; too late, with violent colic ; irregular, lasting only for a few days ; blood dark ; delayed from getting feet wet.
Menses very irregular, appear after 8 or 10 weeks, are very scanty and last but a short time ; discharge pitchy black ; constant pressing headache ; cutting, bearing down pains in hypochondria and hips ; backache ; swelling of abdomen and of upper and lower limbs, with sensation of numbness, crawling and stitching, as if they were asleep ; chilliness ; coldness of hands and particularly of feet ; rapid obesity.
Sensation of lassitude, heaviness and tiredness ; small, round, red, itching, herpetic patches on forearms, neck and throat.
Menses too late and scanty, sometimes black, often pale, with stitches, burning and dryness of vagina.
Scanty menses with congestion to brain.
Scanty catamenia preceded by menstrual colic. θ Gastralgia.
Menses keep postponing, discharge scanty and pale.
Menses suppressed, with weight in arms and legs.
Suppression of menses, with heaviness of limbs and congestion of blood to head.
Eruptions appear during menses.
Non-appearance of menses for five months ; severe congestion to head and chest, with dark redness of cheeks, anxiety and oppression of chest when lying down.
Tendency to spasms ; menses have not appeared for six months ; chronic catarrh of stomach, with frequent eructations ; frequently feels faint, with partial loss of senses ; os uteri standing backwards, and can only be reached with difficulty.
Young woman, chlorotic, irregular menses ; became pregnant, recovery after labor very slow ; œdema of eyelids, vulva and abdominal walls ; menses very late, pale and scanty ; yellowish tint of skin ; vagina cold ; abdominal walls thick, doughy, pitting on pressure ; great aversion to coitus.
Lassitude and heaviness in lower extremities, and chronic hoarseness, a forerunner of tuberculosis ; no menses for three months.
Menostasis.
Anemia, with dryness of vagina.
First menses delayed.
Instead of regular period has leucorrhœa and suffers with constipation ; has grown very fat ; as a child had tettery eruption on both forearms, of which, however, no trace is left.
Œdema pedum from amenorrhœa.
Before and during menstruation fatiguing cough.
Before and during menses cough throughout day, fatiguing chest ; no cough at night.
Leucorrheic discharge occurs in gushes day or night.
Pain in epigastrium during catamenia, as if everything would be torn to pieces, with labor-like pains ; persistent and stinging toothache. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
During menses : dry cough and profuse sweats, morning sickness, swelling of feet and painless swelling of face ; hoarseness, violent coryza and catarrhal fever ; colic ; violent headache with nausea ; morning sickness ; chaffing between legs ; swelling of feet ; chilliness ; pain in varices ; hoarseness with dry cough, headache evenings ; painless swelling of cheeks ; colic-like labor pains ; backache ; heat in abdomen ; urging, pressing, like labor pains ; itching in abdomen ; weakness in feet, that she cannot walk ; pain in abdomen ; growing dark before eyes.
After menses, jerking in arms ; at other times ; pain below navel, as if intestines were torn ; lying upon right side, pain is in left, and vice versa ; reaching with arms high, pain in region of womb ; constipation.
Lassitude and weakness with the catamenia.
Morning sickness of pregnancy or during menses.
Vagina cold. θ Chlorosis.
Biting or smarting in vagina.
Vesicles or excoriations in vagina. θ Pruritus.
Itching, smarting, painful vesicle on vulva ; itching pimples on vulva.
Itching vesicles and pimples on labia, which smart and are painful ; painless pimples on inside of labia.
Painful pressure towards pudenda.
Itching of pudenda before menstruation.
Excoriations in perineum, vulva and between thighs.
Soreness between thighs, near pudenda, during menstruation.
Feeling of external irritation at genitals as if the parts were swollen.
Œdema of pudenda. θ Chlorosis.
Acrid, excoriating leucorrhœa, in gushes, day and night, before and after menses.
Profuse leucorrhœa, with weakness of back and sacrum, when walking and sitting.
Yellowish-white leucorrhœa, excoriating skin ; uterus indurated, swollen and sore ; straining in anus, with protruding piles, and bearing down in bowels long after an evacuation.
Leucorrhœa ; profuse, perfectly white, especially on rising in morning ; weakness of back when walking or sitting, with distension of abdomen, and painful pressure towards pudenda ; discharges occur in gushes day and night ; turbid urine ; frequent micturition, especially at night ; difficult stool ; great lassitude.
Copious, thin leucorrhœa, causing a biting, smarting sensation in vagina.
During climaxis : cardialgia ; gastric catarrh.
Tendency to obesity. θ Uterine complaints.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Graph.]
Large and corpulent women of venous constitution, who are subject to tettery eruptions, which itch and emit glutinous fluid.
Labor pains weak or have ceased entirely.
Nipples painful and cracked.
Sore nipples of nursing women, end of nipple cracked and fissured, exuding a limpid serum.
Hard cicatrices remaining after mammary abscess, retarding flow of milk.
Cancer of mamma, from old cicatrices, which had remained after repeated abscesses.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Graph.]
Voice : impaired ; not clear, in singing ; cracked, in singing.
Hoarseness in evening. θ Coryza.
Chronic hoarseness.
Soreness and roughness of larynx, with tickling cough.
Laryngeal region sensitive to touch.
